issues.message: Longest extent is 1.033 m; a vehicle is expected to be 2.0-25.0 m long. Rescale in metres.

Origin is not at ground level on the centreline.

footprint aligned to the axes by rotating -35.4 deg about the up axis (long side = forward, footprint 0.958 x 0.816)
width and height relative to the length are the model's estimate from ONE view and are often wrong (often too stubby): supply the real width/height to correct the proportions

no vehicle specification supplied: wheel/axle/pivot positions and component roles are artist work (automatic part detection is not implemented); validation WILL report NEEDS_REVIEW for a vehicle category

textures: unwrap + bake colour from the RAW mesh
